author: Russell Brand
description:
Russell recalls the eerie silence outside court and reveals how some of his most difficult moments have brought him closer to God. From standing beside his son in intensive care to facing serious allegations, Russell and Laura reflect on finding God's presence in times of uncertainty, and why Scripture warns us not to conform to the patterns of this world.
